formulation.corridor: same production overlapping convex cover; one variable-length OCP phase per consecutive cover cell; oriented rectangle constrained at 5 base samples/interval plus deterministic exact-certifier wall-cut exchange
formulation.dynamics: same motor, braking, speed, friction-circle and endpoint-speed limits; motor/brake/friction are continuously bounded per interval and rechecked independently
formulation.geometry_integration: 8-point Gauss-Legendre per interval; independent certificate uses production exact clothoid/Fresnel geometry
formulation.initialization_cold: analytic Euler/clothoid route initializer with constant endpoint squared speed; does not use the optimized production trajectory
formulation.process_isolation: each CasADi/IPOPT mesh and each supervised production reference runs in a fresh interpreter; process startup is excluded from solver timing
formulation.wall_constraint_exchange: up to 6 deterministic rounds; exact continuous separator maxima are inserted as additional CasADi wall constraints

structured_reference_note: Independent structured refinement solves are retained only as optimizer-robustness diagnostics. Canonical OCP-vs-structured comparison values live in full_ocp_resolution_control.json.
